name: Medical Murray
old_description: Medical Murray is a contract development and manufacturing organization for minimally invasive medical devices and implants. With our expertise and collaborative approach, we can support your device from concept through commercialization.
about:
Medical Murray was founded in 1996 as a privately owned company in North Barrington, Illinois. The firm began by producing finished medical devices, components, and subassemblies for customers ranging from startups to large OEMs.

The company operates two facilities: a headquarters in North Barrington that houses R&D labs, an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited testing laboratory, and Class 7 cleanrooms for pilot production; and a 45,000-square-foot manufacturing plant in nearby Lake Zurich equipped for cleanroom molding, braiding, coil winding, custom forming, assembly, packaging, and sterilization. Services span design, prototyping, testing, process validation, and full-scale production of catheters, implants, covered stents, bioabsorbable components, and delivery systems.

Medical Murray serves the medical device industry across vascular, gastrointestinal, urologic, aortic, structural heart, neurovascular, cardiovascular, peripheral vascular, orthopedic, and gastroenterology markets. Its customer base includes early-stage startups and established original equipment manufacturers seeking a single source for development, testing, and manufacturing.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, single-source model that integrates assembly, packaging, sterilization, and distribution. Its stated purpose centers on extending patient time with loved ones, devoting attention to customer success, and supporting employee growth, underpinned by core values of helpfulness, happiness, responsibility, trustworthiness, and clever problem-solving.
